_note: Doorbell cam: officers at a woman's door over a slap accusation. Times in SOURCE seconds. Speakers split by voice pitch; verify before posting.
title: COPS THREATENED TO\N*BREACH* HER DOOR

captions.speaker: OFFICER1
captions.text: So you need to unlock the door.

captions.speaker: WOMAN
captions.text: Please, please show me the video.

captions.speaker: OFFICER1
captions.text: I will show it to you.

captions.speaker: OFFICER1
captions.text: If you don't unlock the door,\Nwe'll force our way inside.

captions.speaker: OFFICER1
captions.text: We're trying to do this\Nthe easy way.

captions.speaker: WOMAN
captions.text: I literally waited for you guys\Nto report this for hours.

captions.speaker: OFFICER1
captions.text: Right now, I will\Nbreach this door.

captions.speaker: OFFICER2
captions.text: It's hot pursuit of\Na violent misdemeanor,

captions.speaker: OFFICER2
captions.text: but we can't articulate the exigency\Nbecause the victim's out of here.

pops.text: EXIGENCY = AN EMERGENCY THAT\NLETS POLICE ENTER WITHOUT A WARRANT
